limitations: Only n=3,4,5,6 are claimed; no infinite generalization is asserted.
The n=3 row is already known from friendship graph classification.
Other literature and unpublished computations may overlap.
scientific_integrity: Finite complete construction, exhaustive two-method enumeration, full acyclic matching certificate, integral signed Morse differential and independent mod-two ranks. The n=3 comparison is a known boundary, not novel.
title: First mixed-dimensional strong-Morse homotopy in triangle–cycle bouquets
